g.text: Sequence Diagram - Start Stock Tracking for a Product
validate Product ID and optional non-negative integer
Product identity, name, active state / none
SELECT stock row WHERE ended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
Product has no isStockControlled attribute. A StockInformation
record with endedAt=null represents active tracking for the
stock tracking are separate operations; BCK09 verifies the
Product exists but does not modify the Product aggregate.
An inactive Product may still be administered by the Manager.
The Manager may provide initialUnits. It must be a
non-negative integer; if omitted, the initial quantity is 0.
Each new tracking period receives a new StockId and startedAt.
All completed periods remain stored with their final quantity
and endedAt. Managers can search completed periods through
